```{r libs}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(arrow)
library(purrr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

PROJECT_DIR <- "/home/rstudio/project"
SIM_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data/03_simulation")
PREP_DIR    <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data/01_prepared")
EVAL_DIR    <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data/04_evaluation")

ALPHA <- 0.05
DATASET_ORDER <- c("lung", "pbc", "colon", "rotterdam", "flchain")

PHASE3_LSR_EXCLUDE <- data.frame(dataset = c("lung", "flchain"),
                                 variable = c("ph.karno", "sample.yr"),
                                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
PHASE3_FPR_EXCLUDE <- data.frame(dataset = "flchain", variable = "kappa",
                                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

baseline <- read_csv(file.path(PREP_DIR, "baseline_cox_reffix.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(is_significant = p_value < ALPHA)

load_phase3 <- function(path) {
  read_parquet(path) %>%
    select(any_of(c("dataset", "variable", "p_value", "converged", "epsilon", "iteration"))) %>%
    as.data.frame()
}
p3_ins <- load_phase3(file.path(SIM_DIR, "reffix/all_phase3_reffix.parquet"))
p3_tt  <- load_phase3(file.path(SIM_DIR, "reffix_traintest/all_phase3_reffix_traintest.parquet"))
cat(sprintf("Phase 3: in-sample %d 行 / train/test %d 行\n", nrow(p3_ins), nrow(p3_tt)))
```

```{r denominator}
den <- bind_rows(lapply(DATASET_ORDER, function(d) {
  b <- baseline %>% filter(dataset == d)
  n_sig    <- sum(b$is_significant);  n_nonsig <- sum(!b$is_significant)
  ex_lsr <- sum(PHASE3_LSR_EXCLUDE$dataset == d)
  ex_fpr <- sum(PHASE3_FPR_EXCLUDE$dataset == d)
  tibble(dataset = d,
         `LSR 分母（除外なし）` = n_sig, `LSR 分母（投稿版）` = n_sig - ex_lsr,
         `LSR 減少率` = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * ex_lsr / n_sig),
         `FPR 分母（除外なし）` = n_nonsig, `FPR 分母（投稿版）` = n_nonsig - ex_fpr,
         `FPR 減少率` = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * ex_fpr / n_nonsig))
}))
kable(den, caption = "除外が分母に与える影響") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r kpi-fn}
phase3_kpi <- function(res, excl_lsr, excl_fpr) {
  sig    <- baseline %>% filter(is_significant)  %>% select(dataset, variable)
  nonsig <- baseline %>% filter(!is_significant) %>% select(dataset, variable)
  ok <- res %>% filter(converged)

  lsr_var <- ok %>% inner_join(sig, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
    anti_join(excl_lsr, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
    group_by(dataset, epsilon, variable) %>%
    summarise(lsr = sum(p_value >= ALPHA) / n(), .groups = "drop")
  fpr_var <- ok %>% inner_join(nonsig, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
    anti_join(excl_fpr, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
    group_by(dataset, epsilon, variable) %>%
    summarise(fpr = sum(p_value < ALPHA) / n(), .groups = "drop")

  agg <- lsr_var %>% group_by(dataset, epsilon) %>%
      summarise(mean_lsr = mean(lsr), max_lsr = max(lsr), .groups = "drop") %>%
    full_join(fpr_var %>% group_by(dataset, epsilon) %>%
                summarise(mean_fpr = mean(fpr), max_fpr = max(fpr), .groups = "drop"),
              by = c("dataset", "epsilon"))
  list(agg = agg, lsr_var = lsr_var, fpr_var = fpr_var)
}

NONE <- data.frame(dataset = character(), variable = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

ins_with <- phase3_kpi(p3_ins, PHASE3_LSR_EXCLUDE, PHASE3_FPR_EXCLUDE)
ins_none <- phase3_kpi(p3_ins, NONE, NONE)
tt_with  <- phase3_kpi(p3_tt,  PHASE3_LSR_EXCLUDE, PHASE3_FPR_EXCLUDE)
tt_none  <- phase3_kpi(p3_tt,  NONE, NONE)
```

```{r validate}
check_against <- function(agg, ref_file, label) {
  ref <- read_csv(file.path(EVAL_DIR, ref_file), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(phase == "Phase 3") %>%
    select(dataset, epsilon, mean_lsr, max_lsr, mean_fpr, max_fpr)
  j <- agg %>% inner_join(ref, by = c("dataset", "epsilon"), suffix = c("_new", "_ref"))
  cols <- c("mean_lsr", "max_lsr", "mean_fpr", "max_fpr")
  d <- map_dfr(cols, function(v) {
    a <- j[[paste0(v, "_new")]]; b <- j[[paste0(v, "_ref")]]
    both_na <- is.na(a) & is.na(b)
    diff <- ifelse(both_na, 0, abs(a - b))
    tibble(指標 = v, 照合セル = length(diff), 最大差 = max(diff, na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  stopifnot(nrow(j) == nrow(ref), nrow(j) > 0, all(d$最大差 < 1e-12))
  cat(sprintf("%s: %d 条件 × %d 指標が %s と一致（最大差 %.2e）✅\n",
              label, nrow(j), length(cols), ref_file, max(d$最大差)))
  d
}
v1 <- check_against(ins_with$agg, "kpi_summary_reffix.csv",   "in-sample")
v2 <- check_against(tt_with$agg,  "kpi_traintest_reffix.csv", "train/test")
kable(bind_rows(v1 %>% mutate(アーム = "in-sample", .before = 1),
                v2 %>% mutate(アーム = "train/test", .before = 1)),
      digits = 20, caption = "「除外あり」の再集計が投稿版の掲載値と一致すること") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r delta}
delta_of <- function(w, n, arm) {
  w$agg %>% rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_with"), -c(dataset, epsilon)) %>%
    inner_join(n$agg %>% rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_none"), -c(dataset, epsilon)),
               by = c("dataset", "epsilon")) %>%
    mutate(アーム = arm, .before = 1)
}
d_all <- bind_rows(delta_of(ins_with, ins_none, "in-sample"),
                   delta_of(tt_with,  tt_none,  "train/test"))

long <- map_dfr(c("mean_lsr", "max_lsr", "mean_fpr", "max_fpr"), function(v) {
  a <- d_all[[paste0(v, "_with")]]; b <- d_all[[paste0(v, "_none")]]
  tibble(アーム = d_all$アーム, dataset = d_all$dataset, epsilon = d_all$epsilon,
         指標 = v, 投稿版 = a, 除外なし = b,
         差 = ifelse(is.na(a) & is.na(b), 0, b - a))
})
write_csv(long, file.path(EVAL_DIR, "phase3_exclusion_sensitivity.csv"))

summ <- long %>% group_by(アーム, 指標) %>%
  summarise(条件数 = n(),
            `変化した条件` = sum(abs(差) > 1e-12, na.rm = TRUE),
            `最大 |差|` = max(abs(差), na.rm = TRUE),
            `中央 |差|` = median(abs(差), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
kable(summ, digits = 4, caption = "除外の有無による Phase 3 の KPI の差（全 5 データセット × 15 ε）") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

kable(long %>% arrange(desc(abs(差))) %>% head(12) %>%
        mutate(epsilon = as.character(epsilon)),
      digits = 4, caption = "差の大きい上位 12 条件") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r self-ref}
p3_base <- p3_ins %>% filter(is.infinite(epsilon), converged) %>%
  distinct(dataset, variable, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(dataset, variable, is_significant = p_value < ALPHA)
stopifnot(nrow(p3_base) == 53)

phase3_kpi_selfref <- function(res) {
  sig    <- p3_base %>% filter(is_significant)  %>% select(dataset, variable)
  nonsig <- p3_base %>% filter(!is_significant) %>% select(dataset, variable)
  ok <- res %>% filter(converged)
  lsr_var <- ok %>% inner_join(sig, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
    group_by(dataset, epsilon, variable) %>%
    summarise(lsr = sum(p_value >= ALPHA) / n(), .groups = "drop")
  fpr_var <- ok %>% inner_join(nonsig, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
    group_by(dataset, epsilon, variable) %>%
    summarise(fpr = sum(p_value < ALPHA) / n(), .groups = "drop")
  agg <- lsr_var %>% group_by(dataset, epsilon) %>%
      summarise(mean_lsr = mean(lsr), max_lsr = max(lsr), .groups = "drop") %>%
    full_join(fpr_var %>% group_by(dataset, epsilon) %>%
                summarise(mean_fpr = mean(fpr), max_fpr = max(fpr), .groups = "drop"),
              by = c("dataset", "epsilon"))
  list(agg = agg, lsr_var = lsr_var, fpr_var = fpr_var)
}
ins_self <- phase3_kpi_selfref(p3_ins)
tt_self  <- phase3_kpi_selfref(p3_tt)

den2 <- bind_rows(lapply(DATASET_ORDER, function(d) {
  b <- baseline %>% filter(dataset == d); g <- p3_base %>% filter(dataset == d)
  tibble(dataset = d,
         `LSR 分母: 投稿版` = sum(b$is_significant) - sum(PHASE3_LSR_EXCLUDE$dataset == d),
         `LSR 分母: 自己参照` = sum(g$is_significant),
         `FPR 分母: 投稿版` = sum(!b$is_significant) - sum(PHASE3_FPR_EXCLUDE$dataset == d),
         `FPR 分母: 自己参照` = sum(!g$is_significant),
         `評価係数の合計: 投稿版` = nrow(b) - sum(PHASE3_LSR_EXCLUDE$dataset == d) -
                                     sum(PHASE3_FPR_EXCLUDE$dataset == d),
         `評価係数の合計: 自己参照` = nrow(g))
}))
kable(den2, caption = "分母の比較（投稿版の除外 vs 自己参照ベースライン）") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

inf_chk <- bind_rows(ins_self$agg %>% mutate(アーム = "in-sample"),
                     tt_self$agg  %>% mutate(アーム = "train/test")) %>%
  filter(is.infinite(epsilon))
kable(inf_chk %>% select(アーム, dataset, mean_lsr, max_lsr, mean_fpr, max_fpr),
      digits = 4, caption = "自己参照ベースラインでの ε=∞（in-sample は定義上ゼロになる）") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(ins_self$agg %>% filter(is.infinite(epsilon)) %>%
                select(mean_lsr, max_lsr, mean_fpr, max_fpr) %>% unlist() == 0))
cat("自己参照ベースラインでは ε=∞ の LSR・FPR が厳密に 0 になる（指標が壊れない）✅\n")
```

```{r selfref-vs-paper}
cmp3 <- bind_rows(
  ins_with$agg %>% mutate(アーム = "in-sample", 方式 = "投稿版（除外あり）"),
  ins_self$agg %>% mutate(アーム = "in-sample", 方式 = "自己参照ベースライン"),
  tt_with$agg  %>% mutate(アーム = "train/test", 方式 = "投稿版（除外あり）"),
  tt_self$agg  %>% mutate(アーム = "train/test", 方式 = "自己参照ベースライン"))
d3 <- cmp3 %>%
  pivot_longer(c(mean_lsr, max_lsr, mean_fpr, max_fpr), names_to = "指標", values_to = "v") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = 方式, values_from = v) %>%
  mutate(差 = `自己参照ベースライン` - `投稿版（除外あり）`)
write_csv(d3, file.path(EVAL_DIR, "phase3_selfref_baseline.csv"))
kable(d3 %>% group_by(アーム, 指標) %>%
        summarise(条件数 = n(), `変化した条件` = sum(abs(差) > 1e-12, na.rm = TRUE),
                  `最大 |差|` = max(abs(差), na.rm = TRUE),
                  `中央 |差|` = median(abs(差), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
      digits = 4, caption = "自己参照ベースライン vs 投稿版（除外あり）") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r thresholds}
eps_star_fn <- function(k, arm, mode) {
  lsr50 <- k$agg %>% filter(is.finite(epsilon), mean_lsr <= 0.50) %>%
    group_by(dataset) %>% summarise(eps_lsr50 = min(epsilon), .groups = "drop")
  lsr10 <- k$agg %>% filter(is.finite(epsilon), mean_lsr <= 0.10) %>%
    group_by(dataset) %>% summarise(eps_lsr10 = min(epsilon), .groups = "drop")
  fpr <- k$fpr_var %>% filter(is.finite(epsilon)) %>%
    group_by(dataset, epsilon) %>% summarise(mean_fpr = mean(fpr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(dataset, desc(epsilon)) %>% group_by(dataset) %>%
    mutate(mx = cummax(mean_fpr)) %>% ungroup() %>% filter(mx <= 0.10) %>%
    group_by(dataset) %>% summarise(eps_fpr10 = min(epsilon), .groups = "drop")
  tibble(dataset = DATASET_ORDER) %>%
    left_join(lsr50, by = "dataset") %>% left_join(lsr10, by = "dataset") %>%
    left_join(fpr, by = "dataset") %>%
    mutate(アーム = arm, 除外 = mode, .before = 1)
}
th <- bind_rows(eps_star_fn(ins_with, "in-sample", "投稿版（除外あり）"),
                eps_star_fn(ins_none, "in-sample", "除外なし"),
                eps_star_fn(tt_with,  "train/test", "投稿版（除外あり）"),
                eps_star_fn(tt_none,  "train/test", "除外なし"))
th_self <- bind_rows(eps_star_fn(ins_self, "in-sample", "自己参照ベースライン"),
                     eps_star_fn(tt_self,  "train/test", "自己参照ベースライン"))
fmt <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "> 1000", as.character(x))
th_wide <- bind_rows(th, th_self) %>%
  mutate(across(c(eps_lsr50, eps_lsr10, eps_fpr10), fmt)) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(eps_lsr50, eps_lsr10, eps_fpr10), names_to = "閾値", values_to = "eps") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = 除外, values_from = eps) %>%
  mutate(一致 = (`投稿版（除外あり）` == `除外なし`),
         `自己参照が投稿版と一致` = (`投稿版（除外あり）` == `自己参照ベースライン`))
kable(th_wide, caption = "ε* 閾値: 除外あり vs 除外なし（Phase 3）") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

n_diff <- sum(!th_wide$一致)
n_self_same <- sum(th_wide$`自己参照が投稿版と一致`)
cat(sprintf("\nε* 閾値 %d 個のうち、除外の有無で変わるのは %d 個\n", nrow(th_wide), n_diff))
cat(sprintf("自己参照ベースラインが投稿版と一致するのは %d / %d 個\n", n_self_same, nrow(th_wide)))
if (n_diff > 0) {
  kable(th_wide %>% filter(!一致), caption = "除外の有無で変わる ε* 閾値") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
}

write_csv(th_wide, file.path(EVAL_DIR, "phase3_exclusion_thresholds.csv"))
cat(sprintf("ε* 閾値表を書き出した: phase3_exclusion_thresholds.csv（%d 行）\n", nrow(th_wide)))
```

```{r excluded-behaviour}
ex_lsr <- ins_none$lsr_var %>%
  semi_join(PHASE3_LSR_EXCLUDE, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
  mutate(区分 = "除外された係数")
other_lsr <- ins_none$lsr_var %>%
  anti_join(PHASE3_LSR_EXCLUDE, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
  filter(dataset %in% unique(PHASE3_LSR_EXCLUDE$dataset)) %>%
  mutate(区分 = "同じデータセットの他の係数")
cmp <- bind_rows(ex_lsr, other_lsr) %>%
  filter(epsilon %in% c(0.1, 1, 10, 30, 100, Inf)) %>%
  group_by(dataset, epsilon, 区分) %>%
  summarise(`平均 LSR` = mean(lsr), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = 区分, values_from = c(`平均 LSR`, n))
kable(cmp %>% mutate(epsilon = as.character(epsilon)), digits = 3,
      caption = "除外された係数と他の係数の LSR（in-sample、代表 ε）") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r conclusion}
max_lsr_d <- long %>% filter(指標 == "mean_lsr") %>% pull(差) %>% abs() %>% max(na.rm = TRUE)
max_fpr_d <- long %>% filter(指標 == "mean_fpr") %>% pull(差) %>% abs() %>% max(na.rm = TRUE)
tibble(
  項目 = c("実装の妥当性", "平均 LSR の最大変化", "平均 FPR の最大変化",
           "ε* 閾値の変化", "(3) への回答"),
  結果 = c(
    "「除外あり」の再集計が kpi_summary_reffix.csv / kpi_traintest_reffix.csv と一致（最大差 < 1e-12）",
    sprintf("%.4f", max_lsr_d),
    sprintf("%.4f", max_fpr_d),
    sprintf("%d / %d 個が変化", n_diff, nrow(th_wide)),
    if (n_diff == 0 && max_lsr_d < 0.05)
      "除外は掲載する閾値を 1 つも変えない。実務者が事前に特定する必要はない"
    else
      "除外が掲載値に影響する。Limitations に明記が要る"
  )) %>%
  kable(caption = "実験 H-2 のまとめ") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```
